population: all 1722 ordered distinct nonidentity pairs under the parent p47 centered-lift law
admission: inherit each frozen parent row status; compute heights for every accepted row, including both reduced-relation and non-relation rows
height: Sage rational elliptic point canonical height at precision 128, algorithm pari; record decimal strings and computational status
discriminant: record the exact discriminant of each reconstructed short Weierstrass model; this is not the minimal discriminant
ratio: For each admitted curve take M=max height among selected points and m=min strictly positive height among selected points. The observed ratio M/m is a lower bound on M/mu_E only if mu_E denotes the least positive canonical height on the same rational curve. No equality with mu_E is inferred.
rank_arm: For each distinct admitted curve try Sage rank(proof=True) and gens() in an isolated checked-Sage process with a 30-second wall cap; retain timeout and failure states. Basis data are diagnostic and do not establish mu_E without proof of completeness.
measurement: Correctness and arithmetic diagnostic on the local host; no wall-time performance comparison
run_cap: complete 1722-row parent replay and 20 admitted-row heights; three capped rank arms
